footer.tagline: Rebuild your sets, piece by piece.

story.label: The story
story.title: Bricklack was born in a box of missing pieces.
story.p1: Growing up, sets would get taken apart, pieces would wander off — usually into a sibling's room — and years later, when you finally wanted to rebuild that castle or spaceship, half the inventory was gone.
story.p2: There was no way to know what you had, what you were missing, or where to even start.
story.p3: So we built the tool we always needed.

s1.title: Search your set
s1.desc: Find any LEGO set by name or number. Over 22,000 sets in the catalog, updated automatically.

s2.title: Import the inventory
s2.desc: We pull the complete piece list automatically. Every part, color and quantity — no manual entry.

s3.title: Mark what you find
s3.desc: Go piece by piece through your bins. Check off each one as you find it — progress saves in real time.

s4.title: Complete the set
s4.desc: Watch the progress bar fill up piece by piece. Know exactly what you still need to rebuild.

features.title: Everything you need
features.subtitle: To rebuild any set, piece by piece.

f1.title: Find any set
f1.desc: Access over 20,000 sets and 50,000 parts from the complete LEGO catalog via Rebrickable.

f2.title: Track your progress
f2.desc: Check off each piece you find. The progress bar updates in real time with smooth animations.

f3.title: Identify with AI
f3.desc: Take a photo of a loose piece and AI identifies it: type, color, dimensions, and part number.

f4.title: Always in sync
f4.desc: Your collection in the cloud. Access from any device — mobile app coming soon.
